name: Lanjarón (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lanjarón (a mountain on blue above a castle with crossed swords on red).
history: Municipal flag of Lanjarón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lanjarón arms — mountain above a castle with crossed swords
